name: Cloud Dispatch Cleanup

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Environment to clean up'
        required: true
        default: 'production'
        type: choice
        options:
          - production
          - staging
      dry_run:
        description: 'Perform a dry run without deleting resources'
        required: false
        default: true
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS Credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ secrets.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Run Cloud Cleanup Script
        run: |
          echo "Starting cleanup for environment: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}"
          echo "Dry run mode: ${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run }}"
          
          # Placeholder for actual cleanup logic
          # This would typically involve calling AWS CLI or Terraform to remove unused resources
          # associated with the ComfyUI frontend deployment or asset storage.
          
          if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "DRY RUN: No resources were deleted."
          else
            echo "Executing cleanup operations..."
            # Example: aws s3 rm s3://comfyui-assets-${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}/ --recursive
          fi

      - name: Notify on Failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Cleanup job failed. Please check the logs."
